name: Supermium
tagline: 让老系统也能用上新版 Chromium 的浏览器
taglineEn: A modern Chromium build for older Windows versions
description: Supermium 是一款基于 Chromium 的浏览器，专门针对旧版 Windows（如 Win7、Win8.1）做了兼容优化，让老系统也能跑上较新的 Chromium 内核。教室里的老机器如果装不了新版 Chrome 或 Edge，可以试试它。
descriptionEn: Supermium is a Chromium-based browser specially optimized for older Windows versions such as 7 and 8.1, so aging classroom PCs can run a relatively recent Chromium core. Try it if a machine cannot install current Chrome or Edge.
author: win32ss
